title: Important Notice: Binance Futures Old Trades Lookup API Optimization (2025-03-03)
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Starting from  2025-03-03 08:00 (UTC) , historical market data on Binance Futures before 2025-03-01 00:00 (UTC) will no longer be available via  Old Trades Lookup (MARKET_DATA) .  Users will still be able to manually download historical market data from  Binance Vision Data Portal  at any time. Affected API endpoint:  GET /fapi/v1/historicalTrades Note:  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-02-26
